shots.description: THE LEAP - full Intore line jumps simultaneously, manes airborne, spears up
shots.capcut_treatment: Speed Customized: 1x > 0.5x at apex > 1x on landing. Apex sits ON the downbeat. Sub-boom + real stomp at -3dB
shots.notes: Signature shot. Ramp OFF the beat, not into it.

stock.alt_keywords: Rwandan traditional dance jumping; African warrior dance leaps spears
stock.fallback: THE critical buy. Search every library; check Rwandan contributors on Pond5 directly. If no group leap exists: use a single-dancer leap and build the 'line' with three jump cuts (see 4.16).

shots.description: Landing - feet hit earth, dust explodes upward
shots.capcut_treatment: Speed Customized: 1x > 0.2x for 5f > 1.2x. Bling Shake 12 for 4 frames only
shots.audio: LOUD IMPACT - loudest point in the whole mix
shots.notes: THE signature shot of the film.

stock.keywords: dust explosion feet stomp ground slow motion
stock.alt_keywords: feet landing dust; African dance stomp earth slow motion
stock.fallback: Substitute: generic 'feet hitting dusty ground' slo-mo (plentiful in Western/African desert stock) + the real stomp audio from A3. The audience will not question the geography.

shots.description: CLOSING CARD
shots.capcut_treatment: Text In: Fade+Blur; Out: Fade. Fade to black over last 12 frames.
shots.on_screen_text: UMURIRO W'URWANDA / Come to rest. Leave dancing. / Rwanda - Land of a Thousand Hills
shots.notes: 3 stacked text blocks, staggered 6 frames apart.

stock.fallback: No picture needed: closing card over the tail of 6.08, or over black.

notes: All Kinyarwanda text and any spoken lines must be verified by a native speaker before delivery. Music and all footage must be licensed for the intended distribution.

tiers.D: unavailable - build, crop or stitch it

hard_constraints: Most Rwanda cultural-performance stock is EDITORIAL ONLY - it cannot be used in commercial or tourism-board advertising. Filter by licence before you fall in love with a clip.

Stock is overwhelmingly 24/25/30 fps. Any shot written at 0.35x slow motion will artefact badly from 30 fps even with Optical Flow. Buy native slow motion (100-240 fps) for 3.07, 4.05 and 5.01, or soften the ramp to no lower than 0.5x everywhere else.
Match cuts need matched SHAPE and matched SCREEN SIZE. Buy clips where the subject occupies a similar fraction of frame, or the scale-match keyframes will not hide the cut.
Never mix a 4K clip and a 1080p clip in the same act without upscaling the smaller one - the grain and sharpness difference is obvious on a phone.
